d:
Rus aur yukren men jab se jang shuru huee hai uske bad se ab tak sabse zyada sardi ka samna karne ke lie yukren men kaee parivar khud ko taiyar kar rahe hain. mana ja raha hai ki is bar yukren men tapman tezi se gir sakta hai. vahin yukren men enarji inphrastrakchar par hue rusi hamlon ke chalte kaee gharon men na to bijli hai aur na hi pani. aise men lakhon logon ke samne bara sankat khara hone ka dar sata raha hai. dekhie yah riport.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
